method: Run the offline analyze-memory.mjs against the completed closed attempt, then independently inspect the original report/execution/wrapper evidence, raw first/last-minute values, all minute windows and collected menu checkpoints. No new browser, simulation, forced GC, build, test or production edit. Derived outputs only are added inside this attempt directory; original inputs remain unchanged.

recommendation.suggestedRootStatement: 在记录的 Windows/i7-10700K、Chrome 155 headless、1366×768、驻心脏双生产源压力场景中，冻结 v075 已完成 600.05 active 秒自然采样；逐分钟 used 中位和低位均非持续上升，未观察到持续失控的 V8/DOM 保留。首末一分钟 used 中位仍增加 20.29%，菜单十次重开后 collected used 增加 183,708 B（3.42%），节点回到 451、监听器保持 37；不声称零增长。
recommendation.fullRequirementRowScope: This supplies finite current-version technical evidence for the recorded headless case. It does not, by itself, close native/actual target-device presentation or unmeasured all-route/process-memory parts of the full acceptance row. Root should retain those separately stated scopes rather than relabel this completed ten-minute run as insufficient merely because indefinite stability is unprovable.

naturalInterpretation.interpretation: The positive first/last-minute median is real and remains in the conclusion. It is not accompanied by an uninterrupted rising minute-median or sampled-floor series: standard-phase sampled minima decrease across its first five minutes; after the quality switch the next four minute minima again decrease before a higher final minute. Large and small used falls recur. This is inconsistent with a simple claim that all ongoing allocations accumulate without reclamation in this case. It does not show identical retained bytes or instrument which GC events caused each fall.

populationChecks.sceneLabelCacheCounts: Not sampled by this archived pressure driver. The source-reviewed caps are measurement Map<=256 and placement Map<=128; do not present those as newly observed per-frame browser counters.

postMeasurementInterpretation.method: Only after natural/frame measurement ends: actual pause/menu/start/Q actions, 1.1s settling and three forced GCs per checkpoint. Paused checkpoint can be several simulation ticks later than the terminal natural sample; it is a later retained-size observation, not an exact same-tick image or natural-GC throughput measure.
postMeasurementInterpretation.interpretation: Collected used rises at both recorded restart intervals and is not claimed flat. Its total rise is 183708 bytes rather than a retained copy of the 6-32MB natural occupancy envelope each restart. Collected DOM nodes return to the original menu count and listeners remain 37; embedder used decreases in the second interval and backing is constant there. Together with the bounded presentation roots reviewed in preflight, this provides no identified accumulating old HUD tree/listener or whole-run copy. The remaining byte increase has not been attributed to a retained-object dominator path, JIT, a particular cache or a leak, so those causes must not be invented.
postMeasurementInterpretation.preciseRemainingQuestion: The 183708-byte positive collected menu delta is unclassified. It prevents an exact-zero-retention or indefinitely stable-restart claim. It is not evidence that the measured active ten-minute series had sustained uncontrolled growth, and no additional ten-minute run is required to retain the narrowly stated observation.
postMeasurementInterpretation.prePressureForcedGcBaseline: Not present by design; there was no forced GC during preparation/warmup/natural measurement. These checkpoints demonstrate later release and matched menu differences, not an exact start-vs-end collected-live-heap comparison.
